text: Inspector Clueso confirms the pink team remains guilty. Evidence pending. Verdict not.
Clueso demands a recount after finding zero pink pranks. 'Suspicious,' he says, circling the zero.
Local sources say the witches are watching. Local sources say the witches are always watching.
Neighbor mistakes inflatable pumpkin for suspect. Pumpkin has an alibi and a very firm stance.
PNN reporter reports on PNN reporter. Reporter declines comment, citing conflict of interest and a quiet suspicion of pink.
Clueso loses a pen. Suspects the pink team. Pen found in Clueso's pocket. Suspects the pink team anyway.
Inspector Clueso presses mock charges against the color pink. The color pink declines to comment. It has 'a look.'
A cobweb has been spotted on a porch. Experts say this is Halloween. Clueso says this is evidence.
Tonight: 80% chance of cobwebs, 15% chance of balloons, 5% chance of the Pyro Posse.
Dark, with scattered shenanigans. Winds from the north will carry a faint smell of suspicion.
Football-night outlook: clear skies, empty driveways, and a front moving in from the Pyro Posse.
Frost advisory for porches. Clueso advises bringing in the pumpkins, the bins, and your dignity.
A low-pressure system of bad ideas is forming over the Tightie Whities.
Pink skies at sunset. Clueso reminds everyone: red sky at night, prank team in sight.
The neighborhood group chat expects a 100% chance of 'wait, did you see that?'
Treat futures up 4% as candy hoarding intensifies. Chocolate steady. Gummy worms in free fall.
Balloon stocks soar on Pyro Posse demand. Analysts warn of a hot air bubble.
Clothespin shares surge. Analysts cite 'unusual laundry volume' across the region.
Crepe paper climbs after a strong October. Cobweb futures remain tangled.
Orange flags hit an all-time high. Analysts say it is the one thing they can see from here.
Glow stick demand lights up the market. Investors remain in the dark.
Alibi stock hits a record low. Excuse holds steady.
Pink sunglasses up 3%. Analysts recommend looking unbothered.
Pyro Posse record: three pranks in one night. Official scorers still counting. A fourth was found in the couch.
Black Webb Bandits finish last again, this time in the 'being announced' event.
False start flagged on a photo post. Five yards and the entire prank.
Silver Bullets take the field slowly, unsure, and disoriented. Early lead goes to the laundry.
Area 51 Bureau signs a new balloon-defense coordinator. Coordinator is a trash can.
Tightie Whities clinch a spot in the loose-ends playoffs.
The Crimson Crew is still warming up. Officials note the game started a while ago.
Prowling Purrpetrators sit out the first quarter. Clueso: 'That is exactly what a guilty team does.'
Referees ask teams to stop waving orange flags unless somebody is on offense.
Penalty report: delay of game, false start, and an unnecessary-roughness call on one pair of bloomers.
Slow-moving laundry reported on the clothesline route. Motorists advised to hang back.
Heavy delays at the starting line. The Black Webb Bandits are on their way. They were on their way last week, too.
A pumpkin is on the sidewalk. The pumpkin has not been moved. The pumpkin is thriving.
Cobweb on the corner of Maple and Mischief. Drivers advised to wave.
Orange flags spotted on a lawn. Drivers advised to remain calm and not join in.
Study finds 9 out of 10 pranks are 'better in the plan than in the execution.' The 10th is on a clothesline.
Researchers confirm underwear burns. Researchers were not asked. Researchers are shaken.
Scientists measure the exact amount of hot air in a balloon. Result: 'Posse-adjacent.'
New study: spiders are bad at deadlines but excellent at webs. The Bandits were unavailable for comment.
Archaeologists unearth an ancient prank. It was early and unannounced.
Physicists confirm that a bullet that is slow, unsure, and disoriented is, ballistically, a pebble.
Study finds the human eye can read a For Sale sign through orange cobweb. Understanding it is another matter.
Cats found to be unbothered by cardboard boxes. The Pyro Posse found to be bothered by everything.
Study: 100% of pranks posted early are deleted late.
Researchers find a team without a prank is called 'hiding.' Clueso is thrilled.
Neighbor reports hearing 'a distinct sound of laughter.' The sound has been classified.
Resident finds a bag of balloons in the garage. Asks no questions. Closes the garage.
Neighborhood group chat reaches a new high in 'did anyone see that?'
Resident walks dog downhill. Neighbors immediately ask how long they have owned the dog.
Neighborhood pumpkins file a joint complaint over excessive carving.
A flagpole in the neighborhood reports feeling unemployed. Calls for 'just one flag.'
Porch light on at 3 a.m. Experts say it is a moth. Clueso says it is a prank team.
Neighbors find glow sticks in the lawn. Declare it the best lawn in the neighborhood. For now.
Two neighbors argue over whether 'crape' paper is real. It is crepe. They are both wrong.
Clothesline demand surges. Clothespin supply nervous.
PNN intern asked to count the pranks. Asked to count again. Now the Pyro Posse's accountant.
Resident installs a motion-activated cat. The cat is moving. The resident is not.
Neighbors report a pink glow in the sky. It is the sunset. Clueso says it is a signal.
Reminder: you can only prank a team once. Do not waste it on a bag of balloons.
Reminder: no photo, no points. Post proof to the game group. Blur the plates.
Reminder: nothing may be damaged or destroyed. Fire is not part of the game. Paper flames are plenty.
Reminder: be clever and fun, but don't be mean. Mean is a different channel.
Reminder: wait for the witches' instructions before bribing. Early bribes get a NO. Late bribes get a 'who are you?'
Reminder: pranks and photos by October 22 for points. Procrastinators will be roasted.
Reminder: don't wake anyone up. Sleep is undefeated.
Reminder: no scaring children. Spooky, not scary. Scary is for the movies.
Reminder: please share the fun. A team that has not been pranked yet is starting to feel left out.
Reminder: never share personal information with outsiders. Your neighbor's email address is not candy.
'I have no evidence,' says Clueso. 'That is exactly what they want me to think.'
Clueso reviews 40 hours of footage of a bush. 'Guilty,' he concludes.
Clueso reads the tip pile. Finds nothing on pink. 'They are good,' he says, through his teeth.
Inspector Clueso updates his motto: guilty until proven guilty until further notice.
Clueso requests a bigger magnifying glass. Reason given: the clues are not getting bigger.
Clueso's trench coat declared 'a fashion crime' by a panel of squirrels.
Clueso opens a fresh case file titled 'Pink, Again.' It is blank. He is thrilled.
Clueso holds a press conference. Cancelled for lack of press. Clueso remains at the podium.
Clueso practices his 'I knew it' face in the mirror. Has not yet needed it.
Pyro Posse announces a prank 'so hot it needs a fire marshal.' The marshal says 'pass.'
Tightie Whities release a statement: 'No comment.' The statement is three pages.
Silver Bullets confirm they have a plan. The plan is being located.
Area 51 Bureau denies everything. The denial is classified.
Black Webb Bandits report they are 'on time this week.' Clocks decline to comment.
The Crimson Crew promises a big announcement. Announcement pending. Crew pending.
Prowling Purrpetrators issue no statement. Clueso counts this as a confession.
Pyro Posse spokesperson: 'We have pranked everyone.' PNN: 'That is four teams.' Spokesperson: 'Hot.'
Tightie Whities seen walking a dog. Dog seen walking Tightie Whities.
Area 51 Bureau rumored to have taken in its trash can at last. Source: a trash can.
Black Webb Bandits announce a new strategy: 'Early.' The witches announce a new strategy: 'NO.'
Silver Bullets reportedly 'will be on time.' On time for what remains unclear.
Local pumpkin enters witness protection. Will now be known as 'a gourd.'
Candy corn declared a prank by an expert panel. The panel ate the evidence.
Skeletons vote to unionize. Demands: more bones, fewer chores.
Ghosts reportedly 'shocked' to be called boo-ring.
Bat population up 12%. Bat population unavailable for comment.
The witches announce new instructions. Instructions: wait for instructions.
Pumpkin spice is not a personality, says Clueso, who has pumpkin spice for breakfast.
Inflatable ghost deflates mid-prank. Experts call it the quietest exit of the season.
Mummy wins a fashion award despite a very limited wardrobe.
Vampire reports a minor shortage of mirrors. Nobody has noticed.
Missing: one sense of urgency. Last seen at the starting line. If found, return to the Black Webb Bandits.
A clothespin has gone missing. A clothesline has gone up. Clues: laundry.
A bag of balloons has been left unattended. PNN advises everyone to stay calm and avoid eye contact.
A suspicious pile of small white bits has been found on a lawn. Experts advise against touching, tasting, or explaining.
Orange flags reported in unusual quantities. Alert level raised to 'hot.'
Neighbors urged to check their laundry for unexpected heat.
The night is young. So are the pranks. One is already on the group chat.
PNN Tip Line receives a tip. It is a recipe. Clueso is reviewing the recipe for clues.
The Corrections Desk reports record low corrections. Clueso says this proves PNN is right. Everyone else says nobody is reading.
A tip about the pink team arrives at 3:03 a.m. It is from Clueso.
The Prowling Purrpetrators. Reward: nothing. Last seen: nowhere. Armed with: confidence and an extremely good logo.
Any evidence against the pink team. No questions asked. Several questions asked.
A witch. Must be able to say NO convincingly. Experience with early bribes preferred.
'I do not make accusations. I make conclusions that happen to be accusations.'
'If the pink team looks innocent, that is just them looking busy.'
'A clean record is only a dirty record with better PR.'
'Today I will solve nothing. Boldly.'
Team dossiers are now open. The pink file is the thickest. It contains nothing.
'Please stop sending me tips about the weather.' The weather desk: 'Please stop sending tips.'
'Every team has a motive. Mine has a magnifying glass.'
Official statement: NO. The witches were not asked a question. The witches said NO anyway.
The witches announce an investigation into the people trying to bribe them. The witches also accept treats.
Wanda, Hilda, and Glenda reported 'unbothered.' Sources: three witches, one of whom smiled.
A reminder from the coven: treats first, questions second, early bribes never.
Witch sightings up 100%. Witch identification down 100%. Clueso demands a recount.
Days until the party: fewer than yesterday. Pranks still pending: more than you think.
The party is Saturday, October 24, at 5:30 PM. Your early prank will be forgotten by then. Plan accordingly.
The clock is ticking. So is Clueso's left eye.
Pranks and photos are due by October 22. The party is October 24. Two days of silence is a very long time.
Time is running out to prank, bribe, and find a witch. The witches have all the time in the world.
Black Webb Bandits file updated: 'Reliably last. Occasionally early. Never on time.'
Pyro Posse file updated: 'Fire-themed. Balloon-powered.'
Tightie Whities file updated: 'Briefs filed. Loose ends pending.'
Silver Bullets file updated: 'Slow, unsure, and now laundry-adjacent.'
Area 51 Bureau file updated: 'The truth is out there. So is the trash.'
The Crimson Crew file updated: 'Not in any case. Allegedly exists.'
Prowling Purrpetrators file updated: 'Contents classified.' Contents: nothing. Classified nothing.
Pink teams caught to date: 0. The counter has been checked for dust.
Days since the Black Webb Bandits were on time: unknown. Clueso lost count.
Pranks announced on time: under review. Pranks announced early or late: all of them.
Balloons in the neighborhood: too many. Balloons in the Pyro Posse's garage: yes.
Squirrel union demands recognition from Clueso. Clueso suspects pink has infiltrated the squirrel union.
Local cat declared 'not the pink team.' The cat disagrees.
Experts say the clothesline has become 'the new group chat.'
A suspicious pumpkin was moved overnight. The pumpkin says it was 'voluntary.'
Weather alert: a 90% chance that 'someone is going to find out.' Plan for it.
